title: Coverage Hides Churn: Auditing and Preserving Conformal Decisions as VLM Label Registries Grow
abstract: arXiv:2611.07502v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language classifiers can learn new labels from text alone, so the label lists they serve keep growing. We show that this growth silently changes conformal decisions about old labels. Common softmax-based conformal scores compare each label with an average over all labels; adding labels changes that average, and with it the score of every old label, even when the model, the image, and the old calibration data stay the same. Recalibrating after the update keeps the coverage guarantee, yet across eleven settings it changes at least one old decision on 53-90% of new images. Coverage cannot reveal this, because it checks only the true label: in five controlled settings that keep the old calibration, so that only the normalizer changes, old-class coverage moves by at most 0.01 while 60-67% of images change. We propose a lifecycle audit that measures these changes alongside coverage and set size, and a simple fix, PrefixCP: each class

translated_title: 覆盖率掩盖了决策变动：随着VLM标签注册表增长对保形决策的审计与保持
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言分类器能够仅通过文本学习新标签，因此其服务的标签列表会持续增长。我们证明这种增长会悄然改变关于旧标签的保形决策。常见的基于softmax的保形分数将每个标签与所有标签的平均值进行比较；添加新标签会改变这一平均值，进而改变每个旧标签的分数，即使模型、图像和旧的校准数据都保持不变。在更新后重新校准虽然能保持覆盖率保证，但在十一种设置中，它会在53-90%的新图像上至少改变一个旧决策。覆盖率无法揭示这一点，因为它只检查真实标签：在五个保持旧校准不变的受控设置中（仅有归一化因子变化），旧类别覆盖率最多移动0.01，而60-67%的图像却发生了变化。我们提出一种生命周期审计方法，将这些变化与覆盖率和预测集合大小一同进行测量，并提出一个简单的修复方案PrefixCP：每个类别（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PrefixCP方法，揭示了VLM标签注册表增长时基于softmax的保形分数会因标签均值归一化变化而悄然改变旧标签决策（覆盖率指标无法检测到这种变动），并提供了审计与保持决策稳定性的解决方案。
en_tdlr: Proposes PrefixCP to audit and preserve conformal decisions as VLM label registries grow, showing that softmax-based conformal scores silently change old-label decisions due to shifts in the label-average normalizer—a churn that coverage alone cannot detect.
